quick_skim.title: Action-grounded tissue affordance enables anticipatory auto-framing that lowers surgeon cognitive workload during laparoscopic surgery
quick_skim.abstract: Computational attention models could help surgeons manage the visual demands of laparoscopy, but they require dense spatial labels that are difficult to obtain because surgical intent is highly specialized and tacit. Here, we introduce DiffeoAfford, an action-grounded tissue affordance framework that retrospectively derives visual attention supervision from completed surgical procedures. By combining diffeomorphism-constrained tissue tracking with instrument trajectory analysis, DiffeoAfford generates affordance hotspot labels without manual per-frame annotation. A real-time prediction model trained on these labels anticipates relevant surgical regions and enables AffordView, an assistive auto-framing system for laparoscopic visualization. The proposed framework aligns with expert annotations and intraoperative surgeon gaze, and reduces surgeon cognitive workload during real-world evaluations using subjective, physiological, and behavioral measures.
quick_skim.llm_evidence_en: Real-time prediction model anticipates surgical regions from action-grounded affordances, enabling proactive assistive framing

quick_skim.llm_tldr_cn: 外科手术中的视觉注意预测通常需要密集的空间标注，而手术意图难以手工标注。该论文提出DiffeoAfford框架，利用微分同胚约束的组织跟踪与器械轨迹分析，从已完成手术中自动生成可供性热点标签，无需逐帧人工标注。训练后的实时预测模型能预期相关手术区域，并驱动AffordView自动取景，实验显示可降低外科医生认知负荷。这为手术辅助系统提供了一种可迁移的预期式交互范式。

quick_skim.title: Belief-Aware Influence and Trust (BAIT): Shaping Human Belief During Repeated Human-Robot Interaction
quick_skim.abstract: Repeated human-robot interaction (HRI) requires proactively accounting for humans who continually adapt to evolving beliefs about the robot. Prior frameworks often treat encounters as isolated events, suffering cumulative task performance decay as human perception drifts, or maintain long-term influence through erratic, unpredictable behavior that erodes perceived human trust and relies on computationally unscalable formulations. To address these gaps, we introduce the Belief- Aware Influence and Trust (BAIT) controller. BAIT integrates a hierarchical particle filter, which infers both fast human strategic shifts and slow perceptual belief updates, with a belief-aware Model Predictive Path Integral planner. BAIT explicitly optimizes the trade-off between long-horizon influence and human trust, while enforcing immediate task performance as a strict constraint. Across simulations, a human-subject study, and a real-world GEM vehicle deployments in repeated lane-merging scenarios, BAIT achieves task performance comparable to baselines that optimize long-term influence through unpredictability while yielding significantly higher user trust. The video demonstrating our experiments is available at https://youtu.be/9o4GqKLWDCw.
quick_skim.llm_evidence_en: probabilistic particle filter inference of human belief drives proactive robot actions in repeated HRI

quick_skim.llm_tldr_cn: 针对重复人机交互中人类信念和策略持续演化导致任务性能退化的问题，本文提出信念感知的影响与信任（BAIT）控制器。它将推断人类快速策略转移与慢速信念更新的层次粒子滤波，与信念感知的模型预测路径积分规划器相结合，使机器人能够主动适应用户变化并维持信任。实验表明该方法能有效缓解长期交互中的性能衰减。其为基于概率建模的前瞻性人机交互提供了可迁移的框架。

quick_skim.title: Hybrid Attention Estimation Pipeline for Adaptive HRI Using an Expressive Robotic Head
quick_skim.abstract: This paper presents an applied case study on hybrid visual attention estimation for human-robot interaction using an expressive robotic head based on the InMoov ecosystem. The proposed pipeline combines a fast geometric perception layer with an independent semantic perception layer based on a vision-language model. The geometric layer provides high-frequency face and head-pose information for temporal regulation, while the semantic layer receives only raw egocentric camera frames and produces contextual attention labels related to attention toward the robot, phone use, or attention elsewhere. These signals are integrated through a finite state machine that regulates adaptive interaction behavior, including activation, waiting, interaction resumption, and return to rest. The system was evaluated with 10 participants across 40 trials covering baseline and adaptive interaction conditions. Results show reliable interaction start across all trials, consistent pause behavior in the adaptive distraction condition, and non-redundant semantic information between the geometric and semantic outputs.
quick_skim.llm_evidence_en: visual attention estimation for adaptive human-robot interaction; attention as interaction signal, no direct eye tracking

quick_skim.llm_tldr_cn: 面向人机交互的注意力估计通常仅靠单一感知层，难以同时满足实时调节与语义理解。本文提出一种混合流程，将快速几何层（脸与头部姿态）与基于视觉语言模型的语义层（是否注视机器人、是否在看手机等上下文注意力标签）相结合，并通过有限状态机驱动自适应交互行为。该方法在表情机器人平台上展示了将注意力线索用于自适应人机交互的可行性，可为注视或注意力驱动的主动交互提供借鉴。
